note: The 6*Psi rule is an ESTIMATE and on a model this small it is a poor one: the output head (d x V) and the attention term are a large fraction of a 27k-parameter model, and 6*Psi assumes they are not. At 27.9B the rule is good to a few percent. Recording the discrepancy rather than quoting 6*Psi as if it were exact.
